text: 美中关系全国委员会成立60周年暨2026年度颁奖晚宴10日晚在纽约举办，中美政商界人士近400人出席。与会嘉宾表示，两国元首对新阶段两国关系发展的战略引领至关重要，呼吁扩大共识、管控分歧，共同推动发展稳定健康的美中关系。 美国财政部长贝森特在致辞中表示，美中两国元首在一年内频繁互访前所未有，建立了一种“基于相互尊重和两国人民根本利益的友谊”。当前，两国正就人工智能相关议题建立新的对话机制，旨在防范风险、避免误解。
text_en: The National Committee on United States-China Relations held its 60th anniversary and 2026 annual awards dinner in New York on the evening of the 10th, attended by nearly 400 people from the Chinese and US political and business circles. Attendees said the strategic guidance of the two heads of state on the development of bilateral relations in the new phase is crucial, and called for expanding consensus, managing differences, and jointly promoting a stable and healthy US-China relationship. US Treasury Secretary Bessent said in his remarks that the frequent mutual visits by the two heads of state within a year are unprecedented and have established a friendship "based on mutual respect and the fundamental interests of the two peoples." Currently, the two countries are establishing a new dialogue mechanism on AI-related issues aimed at preventing risks and avoiding misunderstandings.
